headline: Southern New Hampshire concede once in three unbeaten matches
dek: Five different scorers have shared Southern New Hampshire's seven goals, and Inigo Burusco has three of them from thirteen shots. The other nine programmes have conceded thirty-six goals between them, and only Pace have also gone unbeaten.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals are spread rather than carried: Inigo Burusco's three lead the conference, and the top-scoring side has five different scorers behind its seven.

wire.line: Eight of the ten programmes have already drawn a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire have scored seven and conceded one, with both of their wins kept to nil.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrea Farinella has made seventeen saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adelphi have scored once in three matches, and Enrico Cesarini Sforza is the only name on their scoresheet.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Franklin Pierce have scored six and conceded six across a goalless draw, a one-goal win and a one-goal defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twenty-four matches have been played and none is a score gap: every final carries its score.

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire are yet to lose and have conceded only at Queens.

next_match.line: Roberts Wesleyan have already won at Assumption; Saint Anselm's only defeat came at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
